'''Roy Harlison''', along with his older brother, [[Chop Harlison|Chop]], were orphans who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shesharile 5]] after their parents were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] in their home in [[Gallisport]].
